h:
这是我用来生成短视频的简单多模型工作流程。

文本2图像2视频2视频。

1 - FLUX 根据相似的提示创建 3 个相似的图像

2 - CogVideoX 1.5 5B I2V 在这些图像之间创建两个“插值”

3 - 混元V2V解决视频不一致和突然变化的问题，特别是在后台。

https://github.com/chengzeyi/Comfy-WaveSpeed

该版本使用WaveSpeed来加速FLUX和Hunyuan。 Comfy 可能不会将其视为丢失节点，请确保按照上面链接中的安装说明进行操作。

WaveSpeed 的代价是增加 VRAM 使用量。

到目前为止，我只能使用 24GB 运行此工作流程。

o.en:
This is a simple multi model workflow I use to generate short videos.

Text2Images2Videos2Video.

1 - FLUX to create 3 similar images from similar prompts

2 - CogVideoX 1.5 5B I2V to create two "interpolations" between those images

3 - Hunyuan V2V to solve inconsistencies and sudden changes in the video, specially in the background.

https://github.com/chengzeyi/Comfy-WaveSpeed

This version uses WaveSpeed to accelerate both FLUX and Hunyuan. Comfy probably won't find it as a Missing Node, make sure to follow install instructions from the link above.

WaveSpeed comes with the cost of increased VRAM usage.

So far I have only been able to run this workflow with 24GB.
